role: offline upper bound on window feasibility; no deployable policy or method comparison
registration_context: V1 development library rates 0/64, 12/64, 33/64 known; April has 18 power-exceeding windows and all profiles fail dispatch; first-hour diagnostic has zero failures
windows: all 73 complete seven-day hourly starts in each of the three V1 development samples
oracle_information: perfect knowledge of the realized dispatch path; one constant signed baseline power per half-hour
feasibility_model: one signed SOC rate per half-hour, with physical import/export efficiency bounds; dispatcher overrides baseline during active BOA intervals
interior_SOC_constraints: at slot boundaries and the minimum/maximum forced SOC offsets for every distinct accumulated idle duration; include within-minute zero crossings
minimum_power_shortfall: sum requested minus power-bounded import/export energy; if above the V1 energy tolerance, infeasible without an LP
witness: replay the signed-power nominations with the minute workload, independently applying energy clipping and summing any undelivered energy
solver_unresolved: neither an infeasibility proof nor a feasible witness
diagnostic_accounting: record power screens, LP solves and physical witness replays separately from algorithmic optimizer/verifier calls
decision: power-infeasible windows require asset/workload alignment; energy-infeasible oracle windows require model/workload investigation; replayed feasible windows missed by the fixed library identify control/coverage limitations
